answer_1.quote: We formalize SLJA as four interrelated tasks (1) article retrieval (AR) ... (2) criminal element generation (CEG) ... (3) article interpretation generation (AIG) ... (4) legal judgment prediction (LJP) ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated legal articles, criminal elements, article interpretations, charges and terms of penalty as textual rationales

answer_2.quote: We use R@k for applicable article prediction and charge prediction... For CEG task, we extract criminal elements... Precision (P), Recall (R), and F1 score are used... Match score evaluates the exact matches... ROUGE score evaluates the word overlap...

answer_4.quote: We hire 22 workers with a legal background to revise the results generated by ChatGPT... The guideline introduces the definition of each task, the detailed system operations, and an example of data correction... we provide ... correction feedback mechanism ... automatic quality estimation ... manual sampling inspection.
answer_4.guideline: The guideline introduces the definition of each task, the detailed system operations, and an example of data correction; workers perform insertion, deletion, and rewriting operations and check for miss-corrections and grammatical issues.
